name: M3 Mini Metal Portable Wireless Bluetooth Speaker Multi Color – Speaker (Copy) Multicolor
description:
This speaker comes with a strong metal body & Easy to carry anywhere in your pocket.
Click your special moments with just one click
Receive call with built-in mic
Long battery life up to 3-4 hours
True wireless stereo audio performance when paired with another JBL M3 mini
Good quality
No fixed color.
